title: Present with a bow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Box body -->
  <rect x='15' y='40' width='70' height='50' rx='4' fill='#e8433f'/>
  <!-- Box lid -->
  <rect x='10' y='32' width='80' height='16' rx='4' fill='#ff5a56'/>
  <!-- Lid edge highlight -->
  <rect x='10' y='32' width='80' height='5' rx='3' fill='#ff8a86'/>
  <!-- Vertical ribbon -->
  <rect x='42' y='32' width='16' height='58' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <!-- Vertical ribbon highlight -->
  <rect x='42' y='32' width='5' height='58' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <!-- Horizontal ribbon on lid -->
  <rect x='10' y='36' width='80' height='8' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <!-- Horizontal ribbon highlight -->
  <rect x='10' y='36' width='80' height='3' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <!-- Bow left loop -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='26' rx='16' ry='10' transform='rotate(-20 36 26)' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <!-- Bow left loop inner -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='26' rx='10' ry='5' transform='rotate(-20 36 26)' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <!-- Bow right loop -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='26' rx='16' ry='10' transform='rotate(20 64 26)' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <!-- Bow right loop inner -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='26' rx='10' ry='5' transform='rotate(20 64 26)' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <!-- Bow center knot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='7' fill='#ffb800'/>
  <!-- Knot highlight -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='28' r='3' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <!-- Bow tails -->
  <path d='M44 34 L34 52 L40 52 Z' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <path d='M56 34 L66 52 L60 52 Z' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <!-- Tail highlights -->
  <path d='M44 34 L37 48 L40 48 Z' fill='#ffe97a'/>
  <path d='M56 34 L63 48 L60 48 Z' fill='#ffe97a'/>
</svg>
